item.text: [{"task_id":"8fbca751~v","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    source = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    fill = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    size = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    out = grid.copy()","    if size <= 0:","        return out","    points = np.argwhere(grid == source)","    if len(points) == 0:","        return out","    top = int(np.min(points[:, 0]))","    left = int(np.min(points[:, 1]))","    height, width = grid.shape","    for row in range(top, height, size):","        for col in range(left, width, size):","            block = grid[row:row + size, col:col + size]","            if np.any(block == source):","                out[row:row + size, col:col + size] = np.where(block == background, fill, block)","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[4]},"params":{"rule":[0,2,6,4]},"rationale":"Red cells mark occupied 4-by-4 squares on a lattice anchored at the minimum red row and column.
